Summary: Requires the Department of Economic and Community Development to develop a plan to establish an artificial intelligence small business program, incentivizes small businesses to adopt and deploy artificial intelligence for purposes of achieving improvements in productivity and the quality of any products or services offered by such small businesses, establishes a competitive small business environment for the development and deployment of artificial intelligence technologies.

Title: Automated Decision Systems Protections for Employees
Author: Joint Labor and Public Employees
Topics: Audit, Effect on Labor/Employment, Private Sector Use, Private Right of Action, Responsible Use
Summary: Concerns automated decision systems protections for employees, relates to developer of an automated employment-related decision process that is deployed in the state shall provide to the deployer of such automated employment-related decision process all information that such deployer requires to perform such deployer's duties.

Title: Crime of Digital Forgery
Author: Joint Judiciary
Summary: Establishes the crime of digital forgery, provides that a person is guilty of digital forgery when such person, with intent to cause financial injury to another person, creates and disseminates a visual representation or audio recording that such person knows or should have known is a digitally forged likeness.

Title: Connecticut Workforce and a Productivity Gap Surcharge
Author: Joint Finance, Revenue and Bonding
Topics: Effect on Labor/Employment, Private Sector Use
Summary: Concerns the State workforce and a productivity gap surcharge, relates to an augmented productivity tax exemption that ensures that any augmented productivity achieved by an employer is permanently exempt from taxation by the state.

Title: Workforce Development and Working Conditions
Author: Joint Labor and Public Employees
Summary: Concerns workforce development and working conditions in the state, increases workforce development efforts and improve working conditions in the state.

Title: Entertainment Event Tickets
Author: Joint General Law
Summary: Concerns entertainment event tickets, specifies the circumstances in which a ticket reseller may enter into a contract with, or accept consideration from, a purchaser for the resale of a ticket to an entertainment event, establishes and modifies various requirements concerning the sale or resale of a ticket to an entertainment event by way of an Internet website or online technology platform, defines various terms concerning tickets to entertainment events.

Title: Gaming
Author: Joint General Law
Summary: Provides that a master wagering licensee and a licensed online gaming operator, online gaming service provider and sports wagering retailer shall establish a telephone number to enable a person to receive assistance to resolve any problem the person is experiencing with an electronic wagering platform, provides that once an owner of an online account initiates a withdrawal request, such licensee shall not cancel or modify a pending withdrawal except to, among other things, comply with fraud prevention.

Title: Use of Artificial Intelligence
Author: Joint Government Admin and Elections
Summary: Concerns the use of artificial intelligence and other means to generate deceptive synthetic media and affect elections, prohibits distribution of certain deceptive synthetic media within the ninety-day period preceding a primary or election.

Title: Task Force
Author: Joint Labor and Public Employees
Topics: Health Use, Effect on Labor/Employment, Studies
Summary: Establishes a task force to study the effects of artificial intelligence on the trades industry, includes an examination of job displacement of employees in the trades industry as a result of artificial intelligence being used in the trades industry and current coursework and curriculum of the Technical and Education Career System regarding the use of artificial intelligence.

Title: Artificial Intelligence
Author: Looney (D)
Summary: Concerns artificial intelligence, provides that the Technology Talent and Innovation Fund Advisory Committee shall partner with public and private institutions of higher education in the state and other training providers to develop programs in the field of artificial intelligence, including, but not limited to, in areas such as prompt engineering, artificial intelligence marketing for small businesses and artificial intelligence for small business operations.

Title: Health Insurance and Patient Protection
Author: Looney (D)
Summary: Concerns health insurance and patient protection, provides that each health carrier shall file a certification with the Insurance Commissioner for the immediately preceding calendar year, certifying that such health carrier completed a review of such health carrier's administrative practices for compliance with the state and federal mental health and substance use disorder benefit reporting requirements.

Title: Unauthorized Dissemination of Synthetic Intimate Images
Author: Somers (R)
Summary: Prohibits unauthorized dissemination of certain synthetic images.

Title: Unlawful Dissemination of Intimate Images
Author: Hwang (R)
Summary: Concerns unlawful dissemination of intimate images that are digitally altered or created through the use of artificial intelligence, criminalizes unauthorized dissemination of intimate images that are digitally altered or created through the use of artificial intelligence.

Title: Health Carriers and Using Artificial Intelligence
Author: Anwar (D)
Summary: Prohibits health carriers from using artificial intelligence in the evaluation and determination of patient care to safeguard patient access to testing, medications and procedures.

Title: Software Tools and Health Insurance Claims
Author: Looney (D)
Summary: Prohibits any health insurer from using a software tool, including, but not limited to, artificial intelligence or an algorithm, to automatically downcode or deny a health insurance claim submitted by a health care provider without detailed review by a clinical peer.

Title: Creation and Dissemination of Intimate Images
Author: Anwar (D)
Summary: Prohibits the creation and dissemination of intimate images generated using artificial intelligence and without consent, prohibits the production and distribution of deepfake intimate images that are generated without the consent of the individual depicted, establish criminal penalties for violations of such prohibition and make civil remedies available for victims.

Title: Artificial Intelligence
Author: Office of the Governor
Summary: Concerns Artificial Intelligence, implements the Governor's budget recommendations, provides that the Chief Data Officer and agency data officers shall identify appropriate data to make available for use by artificial intelligence systems, machine learning and other statistical means of data analysis.

Title: Energy and Water Efficiency Requirements
Author: Joint Energy and Technology
Summary: Concerns energy and water efficiency requirements for artificial intelligence data centers, requires an owner or operator of an artificial intelligence data center to submit a report to the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection.

Title: Unauthorized Dissemination of Intimate Images
Author: Joint Judiciary
Summary: Concerns unlawful dissemination of an intimate synthetically created image, provides that unlawful dissemination of an intimate synthetically created image to a person by any means is a class D misdemeanor.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Protections for Employees
Author: Joint Labor and Public Employees
Topics: Government Use, Effect on Labor/Employment, Private Sector Use, Responsible Use
Summary: Implements artificial intelligence protections for employees, limits the use of electronic monitoring by an employer, establishes various requirements concerning the use of artificial intelligence systems by employers.

Title: Unlawful Dissemination of Intimate Images
Author: Carpino (R)
Summary: Relates to the unlawful dissemination of intimate images that are digitally altered or created through the use of artificial intelligence, criminalizes the nonconsensual creation and dissemination of deep fake pornography.

Title: Task Force to Study Artificial Intelligence
Author: Lanoue (R)
Summary: Creates a task force to study artificial intelligence and the State workforce, studies the practicality and use of increased artificial intelligence by the State and automation of the size and scope of the State workforce.

Title: Study of the Effect of Artificial Intelligence
Author: Lanoue (R)
Summary: Requires a study of the effect of artificial intelligence on the trades industry, studies the effect of artificial intelligence on the trades industry.

Title: Energy and Water Efficiency Requirements
Author: Rosario (D)
Topics: Energy, Private Sector Use, Responsible Use
Summary: Concerns energy and water efficiency requirements for artificial intelligence data centers, promotes energy and water consumption efficiency in artificial intelligence data centers.

Title: Health Insurers
Author: Menapace (D)
Summary: Prohibits any health insurer from using artificial intelligence as the primary method to deny health insurance claims.

Title: Artificial Intelligence
Author: Chafee (D)
Summary: Prohibits any health insurer from using artificial intelligence to deny health insurance claims.

Title: Creation and Dissemination of Artificial Intelligence
Author: Canino (R)
Summary: Establishes a crime prohibiting the creation and dissemination of artificial intelligence generated pornographic images of a person without such persons consent.

Title: Use of Artificial Intelligence to Replace Teachers
Author: Napoli (D)
Summary: Prohibits the use of artificial intelligence to replace public school educators in providing instruction to and regular interaction with students.

Title: Health Data
Author: Foster (D)
Summary: Concerns health data, establishes additional standards governing the ownership, collection, storage and use of health data.

Title: Use of Certain Software
Author: Rochelle (D)
Summary: Prohibits the use of certain software that uses one or more algorithms to examine data for the purpose of increasing landlord and property manager profits by constraining housing supply and increasing rental rates.

Title: Pricing Algorithms
Author: Rojas (D)
Summary: Prohibits residential rental property owners from using pricing algorithms and competitors' sensitive data to set rental prices.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Synthetic Media
Author: Joint Government Admin and Elections
Summary: Concerns artificial intelligence, deceptive synthetic media and elections, prohibits distribution of certain deceptive synthetic media within the ninety-day period preceding an election or primary.

Title: Residential Rental Property Owners From Using Pricing
Author: Joint Housing
Summary: Prohibits residential rental property owners from using pricing algorithms and competitors' sensitive data to set rental prices.

Title: State Agency Contracts for the Licensing of Software
Author: Joint Government Admin and Elections
